home: Hey, I'm Sofija! Sofija has survived in the IT business for fifteen years and in motherhood for five. Product professional with over a decade of experience in various product roles — from strategy to delivery, from enterprise to startup. AI enthusiast and founder of StrongME, a movement and wellness concept I built from scratch. And a mum of two — easily the most complex, most rewarding product I have ever shipped. WORK I'm a Product Manager with a PhD in Computer Science and over a decade of international experience across a range of industries — including power grid management, publishing, fire safety, and academic research. Most recently, I built a RAG-based AI system for a 40,000+ user platform, and founded StrongME — taking both from zero to live. LIFE What brings joy and balance to my life is a mix of simple, meaningful moments — spending time with family, strumming my ukulele and singing, nurturing plants in the garden, staying active through sports and capturing the world through my lens.
work: From global enterprises like Siemens and Schneider Electric to the fast-paced world of a medium-sized startup like ASMIQ, and then back to Siemens again — my career has been a journey across diverse tech ecosystems. Stepping away from a corporate PM role turned out to be one of the most productive periods of my career. I architected and delivered a RAG-based conversational AI system for International School Community — a platform with 40,000+ users and 55,000+ comments. At the same time, I founded StrongME — a movement and wellness concept — and took it from idea to live business: brand, website, class design, customer acquisition, and delivery.
independent_work: In 2025 I stepped away from my corporate PM role at Siemens and used the time to build things from scratch — technically, creatively, and commercially. I architected and delivered a RAG-based conversational AI system for International School Community — a platform with 40,000+ users and 55,000+ comments — handling everything from embeddings and semantic retrieval to LLM response generation at scale. I also built the AI chat feature on this very website. At the same time, I founded StrongME — a movement and wellness concept — and took it from idea to live business: brand, website, class design, customer acquisition, and delivery. All of it.
strongme: StrongME is a movement and wellness concept founded by Sofija Hotomski. StrongME is a group movement class that combines rhythmic cardio and strength training, playful movement with soft cloths and pom poms, and a guided closing practice of stretching, mindful breath, and embodied awareness. The class is 60 minutes and takes place every Saturday and Sunday at 10:30 AM at Zentrum Elch ACCU, Otto-Schütz-Weg 9, 8050 Zurich. The first class is free. A single class costs 35 CHF. A 6-pack costs 180 CHF. Book at www.strongme.pro or contact info@strongme.pro. StrongME Corporate is a 20-minute midday session for office teams: 10 minutes of joyful movement, 5 minutes of functional strength, and 5 minutes of guided relaxation.
sport: Sport saved me. Then I had to learn to listen to my body. A few years ago, burnout and health issues brought me to my knees. The one thing that kept me going was sport. I went all in with Insanity — the intense program from Shaun T. It delivers results, but I overdid it. My body started sending signals I could not ignore. I realised I needed something different — movement that rebuilds rather than depletes. So I built StrongME: joyful, structured, and designed to nourish the body, not conquer it. I built it for myself first. It worked. Then I decided to share it. Learn more at www.strongme.pro.
life: What brings joy and balance to my life is a mix of simple yet meaningful moments: spending time with my family, strumming my ukulele and singing, nurturing plants in the garden, staying active through sports, and capturing the world through my lens. I feel my best when I find myself at the top of a mountain — literally. And living in Switzerland was a good choice. The stillness, the views, the fresh air — it's where I recharge and reflect.

PhD_project: GuideGen: During my PhD I tackled the challenge of keeping requirements and acceptance tests aligned as software evolves. I developed GuideGen, a method and tool that automatically guides testers on how to adapt acceptance tests when requirements change, notifies stakeholders in real time, and raises warnings when mismatches are detected. GuideGen is a web application written in Java using Servlet and JSP technology, deployed on Apache Tomcat.
family: I come from a family where thinking deeply and caring deeply went hand in hand. My dad was a university professor who taught artificial intelligence and mathematical logic. He shaped us — his four daughters, all engineers, now scattered across three continents. My mum was a primary school teacher and a true fighter — she survived breast cancer in 2011. I met my husband at work in 2012, we moved to Switzerland and married in May 2015. We have a cat Bumi, a son Petar born in 2021, and a daughter Nina born in 2023.
gardening: Since March 2025 I started my first real gardening adventure. I planted tomatoes, cucumbers, zucchini, carrots, spring onions, radishes, and spinach — all from seed. The radishes and spring onions have already made it to our plates. The zucchini had other plans.
friends: I am a social butterfly. I keep in touch with people from my highschool and university days and I love meeting new people, hearing new stories and sharing mine. I am grateful for all the friends I met once I moved to Zurich.
animals: I adore animals. I have a cat, Bumi, who is the queen in the house. I also love dogs and any furry animals. My dream is to have a shelter one day.
